subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 110 ((AF)D-38). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment) and INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From AFL: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From INFO-ALGN: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From CULT-INFO-DY: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: INTR (interpretation). From POL-DYM: POST (postulation).
